body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note: Speculative long, sized as an option rather than a core holding. ELT is a single-asset tin developer. Whether it re-rates depends on one gate, the primary permits at Oropesa. That gate has a clear outcome, a strong tin price is helping, and two credible holders are on the register. Getting from permits to production will still dilute shareholders, so the return depends on tin staying high while the funding is raised
